name: Britannia nice time
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar (26%), Refined Palm Oil, Coconut Products (4.5%) (Desiccated Coconut & Coconut Milk Powder), Milk Solids, Invert Sugar Syrup, Edible Maize Starch, Raising Agents [503(i), 500(i) & 450(i), Emulsifiers [322(i), 471 & 472e], Iodised Salt And Artificial (Coconut & Vanilla) Flavouring Substances.
